criteria.name: Asynchronous Outbox and Queueing
criteria.description: Outbound email/SMS sending is decoupled from HTTP handlers via transactional outbox or background queue.

scale.3: Full transactional outbox pattern implemented; zero synchronous SMTP/HTTP provider calls in request handlers.
scale.2: Background thread used, but not written to durable DB outbox table first.
scale.1: Synchronous outbound call with short timeout.
scale.0: Blocking synchronous mail send inside web request loop.

criteria.name: Safe Escaping and Plain-Text Alternatives
criteria.description: Dynamic template interpolation auto-escapes HTML and provides plain-text fallback content.

scale.3: Auto-escaping active on all dynamic parameters; clean plain-text alternative generated.
scale.2: Escaping active, but plain-text alternative missing.
scale.1: Partial escaping or raw format string interpolation.
scale.0: Raw HTML string concatenation creating stored XSS or injection vulnerabilities.

criteria.name: Bounce Handling and Suppression Lists
criteria.description: Bounce/complaint webhooks record hard bounces to suppression table and abort future sends to those addresses.

scale.3: Automated suppression table lookup before sending and webhook ingestion for bounces/complaints.
scale.2: Suppression list exists, but webhook handling is manual.
scale.1: Bounces logged but addresses not suppressed from subsequent runs.
scale.0: No bounce handling or suppression list; repeated delivery attempts to dead addresses.

criteria.name: Exponential Backoff Retries and Opt-Out Compliance
criteria.description: Exponential backoff retries with DLQ after 3 failures; unsubscribe headers and link provided for non-transactional mail.

scale.3: Exponential backoff with DLQ on terminal failure, and List-Unsubscribe header + link implemented.
scale.2: Retries implemented, but unsubscribe link missing header format.
scale.1: Immediate retries without backoff or missing opt-out mechanism.
scale.0: Unbounded retries causing mail storms or zero unsubscribe capability.
